sents.text: Crystal version. A quick trip down memory lane.
Two thousand one. For the first time ever, you could play as a girl.
And the monsters finally moved! Every battle started with a little animation.
Suicune was the star. You chased it all across Johto.
One step too close, and it ran away. Every single time.
Then came the Battle Tower. Seven battles in a row. No items, no mercy.
And when you finally caught Suicune? Pure magic.
Did you play Crystal? Comment below, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse for more memory lane.
